quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #15
										  					
  

25 Questions • Passing Score 20

questions.question: What do double solid yellow lines in the middle of the road mean?

options.text: You cannot pass in either direction.
You can pass in either direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: You cannot pass in either direction.
questions.explanation: Double solid yellow lines mean you cannot pass. You can only cross these lines to turn left or to pass pedestrians, bicyclists, or scooter riders when the opposite lane is clear and safe.

questions.question: A leaky exhaust system is dangerous because it can cause:
questions.correctAnswerText: Carbon monoxide poisoning.
questions.explanation: The exhaust system removes harmful gases from your vehicle. A leak can allow carbon monoxide to enter the passenger area. Fix any exhaust leaks right away.

questions.question: You see flashing signals at a railroad crossing. What should you do?

options.text: Stop and look for a train.
Slow down and look for a train.
Look for a train and then speed up.
Do what the vehicle ahead of you does.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and look for a train.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing with warning signals, you must stop at least 15 feet from the nearest rail. Watch for other warning signs like crossing gates or sounds of an approaching train.

questions.question: What does a red arrow on a traffic light mean?

options.text: Stop and then go when the way is clear.
Stop and wait for a green light or green arrow.
You can turn in the direction the arrow points.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and wait for a green light or green arrow.
questions.explanation: A red arrow means you must come to a full stop and stay stopped until a green light or green arrow appears, unless a sign says otherwise.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They warn of upcoming hazards. This sign tells you a traffic light is ahead so you can prepare to stop or slow down.

questions.question: When can you pass another vehicle?

options.text: On a curve or hill because other vehicles are unlikely to be coming.
By driving on the shoulder of the highway.
If your lane has a solid yellow line and the passing lane is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: None of the above.
questions.explanation: Do not pass on curves or hills because you cannot see oncoming traffic. Never drive on the shoulder to pass. Do not cross solid yellow lines to pass.

questions.question: When you hear a fire engine siren behind you, you must:

options.text: Pull over to the side and stop.
Speed up and take the nearest exit.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull over to the side and stop.
questions.explanation: When you hear an emergency vehicle siren, pull over to the side of the road and stop.

questions.question: Bicycles on the road:

options.text: Must always give way to motor vehicles.
Do not have to follow rules of the road.
Have the same rights and responsibilities as motor vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: Have the same rights and responsibilities as motor vehicles.
questions.explanation: Bicycles are vehicles with the same rights and responsibilities as motor vehicles. Drivers should respect bicyclists' rights on the road.

questions.question: Drivers must yield to a pedestrian:

options.text: Even if the pedestrian is crossing carelessly.
Only if on the same side of the road.
Only if the pedestrian signals you to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Even if the pedestrian is crossing carelessly.
questions.explanation: You must always yield to pedestrians in the street, even if they are crossing against a red light or being careless.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves left, then right.
The road curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves right and then left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: Distracted driving can be caused by:

options.text: Talking or texting on a cell phone.
Changing the radio station or CD.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: Drivers make about 200 decisions for every mile they drive. It is important to keep your full attention on driving. Doing other tasks while driving creates a dangerous distraction.

questions.question: If you stop along the road at night, you should:

options.text: Turn on your emergency flashers and keep your low beams on.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn on your emergency flashers and keep your low beams on.
questions.explanation: When you stop on the road at night, turn on your emergency flashers and keep your low beam headlights on. This helps other drivers see your vehicle clearly.

questions.question: To check your blind spot when changing lanes to the left, look:
questions.correctAnswerText: Over your left shoulder.
questions.explanation: To check your blind spot, look over your shoulder in the direction you want to move.

questions.question: Distracted driving is:

options.text: As safe as driving under normal conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Extremely risky.
questions.explanation: Distracted driving is extremely risky. It puts you, your passengers, pedestrians, cyclists, and other drivers in danger. Focusing on driving helps prevent crashes.

questions.question: On some highways, what directs drivers into the correct lanes for turning?

options.text: White lines on the side of the road.
White arrows in the middle of the lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: White arrows in the middle of the lanes.
questions.explanation: White arrows show which lanes to use for specific purposes, such as driving straight or turning.

questions.question: When stopped at a railroad crossing with more than one track, you should:

options.text: Wait until you can see clearly down all tracks before proceeding.
Stop on the first track and watch for another train.
Go as soon as the train passes.
Go when one track is free.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait until you can see clearly down all tracks before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing with multiple tracks, do not move as soon as a train passes. Wait until you can see clearly down all tracks. Even with one track, check again for another train that may be coming.

questions.question: A flashing red light means:

options.text: The same as a stop sign.
You do not have to stop completely.

questions.correctAnswerText: The same as a stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means the same as a stop sign. Stop completely, yield to traffic and pedestrians, and only go when it is safe.

questions.question: Worn or bald tires:
questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: Worn or bald tires increase stopping distance and make turning harder. Tires without good tread also increase the risk of hydroplaning.

questions.question: When driving in fog, you should:

options.text: Turn on your low beam headlights.
Drive at the maximum speed limit.
Not drive faster than 10 miles per hour.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn on your low beam headlights.
questions.explanation: Use your low beam headlights in fog when you cannot see 500 feet ahead. Do not use high beams—they reflect light back at you and make it harder to see.

questions.question: An octagonal sign is always a:
questions.correctAnswerText: Stop sign.
questions.explanation: All eight-sided signs are stop signs. Come to a complete stop at a red octagonal sign.

questions.question: Can you drive around or under a gate that is being lowered or raised at a railroad crossing?

options.text: Yes, if a train is not too close.
Yes, if your vehicle will not damage the gate.
Yes, if you look both ways first.

questions.correctAnswerText: No, never.
questions.explanation: Flashing red lights, lowered gates, and bells at a railroad crossing mean you must stop completely. Do not cross the tracks until the lights and bells stop and the gates are fully up. Never drive around or under a moving gate.

questions.question: Which statement about winter driving is false?

options.text: Winter is the hardest season to drive in.
Check your antifreeze and windshield washer fluid often in winter.
It is safe to use cruise control in winter weather.
Snow tires are the best choice for winter driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: It is safe to use cruise control in winter weather.
questions.explanation: Do not use cruise control on snow, rain, fog, or other hazardous conditions. Winter is the hardest driving season and requires extra care. Check antifreeze and windshield washer fluid regularly. Snow tires improve traction on slippery roads.

questions.question: What do round signs mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: A railroad crossing is ahead.
questions.explanation: Round signs warn drivers about upcoming railroad crossings. Be extra careful when you see this sign.

questions.question: You are driving at night and another vehicle is coming toward you. Your headlights should be:

options.text: On either high or low beam.

questions.correctAnswerText: On low beam.
questions.explanation: Do not use high beam headlights when another vehicle is approaching or ahead of you. Use low beam headlights to keep everyone safe on the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Two-way traffic.
questions.explanation: Warning signs prepare drivers for road conditions and hazards ahead. They are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that traffic may be coming from the opposite direction.
